stages.question: What are we building, from what source, and how will we know it is done?
Which stack fits this lane, and where will it actually build?
What do the screens look like, and do real captures pass the judge?
Does a first slice build, serve, and screenshot in this sandbox?
Are schema, auth, gates, and jobs proven by executed checks?
Does each route or component pass its check in the production build?
Does the real app on a clean simulator or device do what the spec says?
Do AI features run without paid keys, validate outputs, and stay deterministic where they must?
Can the verification fail, and did someone other than the builder run it?
Is the release request complete and held at Gate-D?
Did the mission's lessons reach the ledger and the owning skills?
